title: Turbine Blisk Internal Passages Superfinishing
challenge: Complex internal aerofoil cooling passages suffered from micro-scratches and recast layer following EDM, creating stress concentrations.
solution: Multi-axis selective MMP formulation filtered high-frequency surface wave-lengths without eroding leading edge tolerances.
process: Passage roughness sampled by replica casting before and after, aerofoil profile scanned on a CMM, and wall thickness re-confirmed at thinnest sections.
result: Internal cooling passage roughness fell from Ra 0.80 µm to Ra 0.03 µm with no dimensional deviation, extending fatigue life by +280%.

title: Solid Carbide Gun Drills Edge Honing
challenge: Micro-chipping on cutting edges led to premature tool failure during deep hole automotive crankshaft drilling.
solution: Controlled MMP micro-edge honing imparted an exact 15 µm symmetric edge radius while polishing flutes to mirror brilliance.
process: Sub-micron aggregate formulation tuned to remove micro-serrations along the cutting line while polishing flute valleys for laminar chip evacuation.
result: Edge chipping completely eliminated and tool life extended by +320% across 50,000 hole cycles.

title: Femoral Knee Component Mirror Finish Without Edge Rounding
challenge: Hand polishing reached mirror finish on the bearing surface but rounded transition edges inconsistently from operator to operator.
solution: Replaced manual buffing with an automated MMP cycle that treats the whole bearing surface uniformly without rounding critical blend radii.
process: Five-point profilometry verification per component with shadowgraph edge inspection against the CAD master.
result: Consistent Ra 0.02 µm achieved across 100% of implants with zero batch rejection.

title: Helical Gear Set, Micropitting Under Sustained Torque
challenge: Ground helical gears showed micropitting on the flanks after endurance running due to directional peak stresses breaking the oil film.
solution: MMP treatment selectively removed directional grinding peaks while preserving gear tooth profile and tip relief intact.
process: Flank roughness traced before and after across multiple teeth on a Klingelnberg gear analyzer.
result: Flank roughness reduced from Ra 0.62 µm to Ra 0.11 µm with zero micropitting after full endurance load testing.

title: Laser-Fused Bracket, As-Built Roughness on a Flight Part
challenge: Sintered powder particles on 3D printed aerospace brackets created high friction and fatigue crack initiation sites.
solution: MMP treatment polished internal contours and lattices without thinning critical thin-wall features.
process: Volumetric flow-based MMP formulation penetrating interior voids and external mounting faces simultaneously.
result: As-printed roughness dropped from Ra 18 µm to Ra 2.4 µm with full dimensional compliance.

title: Mould Cavity, Release Drag Across Multi-Cavity Tool
challenge: EDM texture in deep mold ribs caused part sticking, high ejection forces, and cosmetic drag marks on molded optical casings.
solution: Applied isotropic non-directional MMP polish that eliminates demolding resistance without rounding sharp shutoff corners.
process: Precision masking on parting lines with targeted cavity media finishing.
result: Ejection forces dropped by 45%, cycle time reduced by 3.2 seconds, and cosmetic drag marks eliminated.
